headline: Small, clean SE windswell — dawn patrol log session, nothing more.
today: Waist-high at best but a decent SE angle and cross-off wind all day keep it clean, so it's rideable if you're not picky. Grab the log and work the pushing tide toward the 2:03p high; the morning's fine too, just tiny. Don't drive anywhere for this, but it's a fun coffee session at the home break.

daysToWatch.note: Best home-break day of the week — 2-2.5ft with a good E angle and offshore wind all morning. Groveler or log, fish the tides around the 5:15p high.
Prime ESE angle at 7s and clean cross-off through morning. Surf early — S wind swings onshore and ramps to 17mph by evening.
Bigger on paper but marginal SSE angle and 19-25mph wind. Blown out, skip.
